name: Urban Company Ltd
about: Incorporated in December 2014, Urban Company is a technology-driven, full-stack online marketplace offering home and beauty services.[1]
keyPoints: Business Overview:[1] Urban Company operates a technology-driven, full-stack online marketplace for home, beauty, and wellness services. It runs a technology-driven, full-stack online marketplace for home and beauty services: cleaning, pest control, electrician, plumbing, carpentry, appliance repair, painting, skincare and grooming. It also offers on-demand home help and sells its own Native water purifiers and electronic door locks
pros: Company is expected to give good quarter
cons: Stock is trading at 13.1 times its book value
Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Promoter holding has decreased over last quarter: -1.79%
Company has a low return on equity of -1.86% over last 3 years.

announcements.text: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release 20 Nov - Urban Company raises ₹2,500 crore via QIP, oversubscribed 6x at ₹156/share.
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Allotment 19 Nov - QIP allotment of 16.02 crore shares at ₹156, raising ~₹2,500 crore.
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation 19 Nov - Urban Company to hold virtual analyst/investor meetings on Nov 25, 2026 with Sohum, ABN Capital, Eternalis.
Outcome Of Fund Raise Committee Meeting 19 Nov - QIP closed; allocates 16.02 crore shares at ₹156, 3.12% discount to floor ₹161.03.
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Qualified Institutional Placement 19 Nov - Urban Company QIP closed; 16.02 crore shares allotted at ₹156, 3.12% discount to floor.
